senses.gloss: (not … ם) m. (μαϊουμᾶς, S., majuma) May-day; largess (to soldiers); a kind of mock sea-fight (in Rome). Tanḥ., ed. Bub., Sh’mini 8; Num. R. s. 10 כל שבט … היה לו מ׳ וכ׳ each tribe had its own May-day.
